items.title: Bitcoin ETF Flows Flash Warning, but Broader Demand Stays Positive
items.summary: Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $484.9 million on October 7, but positive 30-day and three-month flows argue against a confirmed reversal in demand.

items.title: Gate Partners with Visa to Launch Crypto-linked Card Across 40+ Countries and Territories
items.summary: Gate has announced a collaboration with Visa to launch a crypto-linked card, further expanding the use of digital assets in everyday spending and global commerce. The product is expected to launch across 40+ markets globally, allowing users to make payments with digital assets online and in-store wherever Visa is accepted and more conveniently connect their Gate accounts with real-world spending. items.title: Is the UK Becoming One of the World's Most Hostile Crypto Tax Jurisdictions?
items.summary: UK crypto tax reporting is set to widen through CARF, while proposed HMRC powers could increase domestic data access without being final law.

items.title: HTX Ventures Publishes New Report on the Convergence of CeFi, DeFi, and TradFi
items.summary: HTX Ventures, the global investment arm of HTX, has published a new report titled The Convergence of CeFi, DeFi, and TradFi in 2026: How Institutional-Grade Hybrid Architecture Is Taking Shape. The report examines how CeFi, DeFi, and TradFi are converging to form a new institutional digital-asset architecture. items.title: Glamsterdam Upgrade: Sepolia Blocks Leave Most of Ethereum's New Gas Capacity Unused
items.summary: Ethereum’s Sepolia gas limit test produced all scheduled blocks, but sampled usage stayed below half of the new capacity, leaving mainnet timing open.

items.title: Polygon Open Money Stack Expands to TRON, Extending Network Access to Regulated U.S. Payment Rails
items.summary: Dubai, UAE – October 8, 2026 – Polygon Labs today announced that Polygon Open Money Stack now supports the TRON network, giving fintechs, remittance providers and payment platforms a way to connect bank funds directly into the world’s largest network for USDT (TRC-20). items.title: USDC Transfers Are Coming to Samsung Wallet
items.summary: Samsung Wallet plans USDC transfers for eligible U.S. users in October 2026, with crypto-wallet and bank payouts across more than 60 countries.

items.title: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin, Then Bought 11,000 Back. Here's Why
items.summary: Metaplanet disclosed that it sold 10,000 BTC during the third quarter for roughly $790 million before buying 11,000 BTC for around $950 million. The company says the exercise was designed to demonstrate that its Bitcoin treasury can provide liquidity when required, while leaving it with a net increase of 1,000 BTC.

items.title: What is Crypto Bunker Mode? Ethereum's Justin Drake Warns of a Possible AI Break
items.summary: Crypto Bunker is Justin Drake’s plan for gradual fund migration, not proof that AI has broken Bitcoin or Ethereum cryptography.

items.title: XRP News: Brevan Howard Deal Broadens Ripple's Scope
items.summary: Ripple Prime will provide Brevan Howard funds with multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing, but the announcement confirms no XRP use.

items.title: Ethereum ETFs Lose $201.9 Million As Bitcoin Funds Return To Inflows
items.summary: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $201.9 million in net outflows on October 6, according to Farside Investors. Bitcoin ETFs moved the other way with roughly $118.8 million of net inflows, creating a sharp one-day divergence between institutional flows into the two largest crypto assets.

items.title: XRP Price Eyes New Catalyst as Ripple Partners With South Korea's Meritz
items.summary: Ripple and Meritz Securities will assess custody and tokenization tools in South Korea, with no launch, XRP use or timetable confirmed.
